backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing topics, lessons, and example presets with CRUD-style methods and query accessors.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping implemented features to corresponding frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend components and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme configuration defining light and dark mode CSS variables and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx as the entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes for all pages using SiteLayout as the root component.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Reusable destructive alert displaying an error message with optional retry button.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Loading card with spinner and skeleton placeholders, optionally showing a custom message.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Global layout with header navigation, mobile menu, main content outlet, and footer attribution.
frontend/src/components/lessons/LessonVi: Displays lesson content for a selected topic, falling back to built‑in default lessons if none are fetched.
frontend/src/components/lessons/TopicSid: Renders a sidebar listing selectable topics, using provided or default topic data.
frontend/src/components/playground/Playg: Provides input fields and buttons for inserting, deleting, searching, and resetting data structure state based on user actions.
frontend/src/components/playground/Sampl: Loads and displays example presets for a topic, using API data or defaults, and allows users to load a preset into the playground.
frontend/src/features/playground/models/: Implements reducer-based state management for playground data, supporting insert, delete, search, pop, reset, and preset loading.
frontend/src/features/visualizations/alg: Generates and animates bubble sort steps from user input, providing playback controls and visual comparisons.
Provides BFS/DFS step generation and a UI that animates graph traversal using GraphViz and stepper controls.
Generates insertion sort steps and renders an animated visualization with user input and stepper controls.
frontend/src/features/visualizations/com: UI controls for play, pause, stepping, reset, and speed adjustment in animations.
Displays the current animation step caption and step count.
frontend/src/features/visualizations/dem: Chooses and renders a data‑structure visualization component based on a topic ID and optional playground data.
frontend/src/features/visualizations/ste: Custom hook managing animation steps, play state, timing, and speed.
frontend/src/features/visualizations/viz: Renders an array as cards with optional highlighted index.
Builds a BST from input values and renders it as a tree of nodes.
Draws graph nodes in a circular layout with edges and optional visited/active highlighting.
Visualizes a heap level‑by‑level based on its array representation.
Displays a linked list horizontally with cards, arrows, and optional highlighted node.
Renders a queue visualization showing elements from front to rear with cards and arrows.
Displays a stack visualization with elements stacked top-down and highlights the top item.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identities, and state management for authentication.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode values, and custom utilities.
frontend/src/lib/queries/lessons.ts: Fetches lessons for a given topic using the backend actor.
frontend/src/lib/queries/presets.ts: Retrieves example presets for a topic through the backend actor.
frontend/src/lib/queries/topics.ts: Loads all topics or a single topic from the backend using react-query.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, providing query and identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page describing the platform’s purpose, features, and usage guidance.
frontend/src/pages/AlgorithmsPage.tsx: Shows sorting and graph traversal visualizations with selectable algorithms.
frontend/src/pages/DataStructuresPage.ts: Displays data structure lessons and demos with topic navigation and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero image, feature cards, and navigation links to learning sections and playground.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Simple 404 page displaying an error message and a button back to home.
frontend/src/pages/PlaygroundPage.tsx: Interactive playground page allowing users to pick a data structure, adjust controls, load presets, and view live visualizations.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata and feature list describing goals, requirements, and existing functionality for the data structure visualizer.
